bayts.text: I was saved from the trials of the enemies when they aimed at me with cannons, all of them, and with knives.
I turned penitent to You when they confronted me with harm, and You tamed them all for me like the destitute.
Bless the Prophet with peace, with the noble, and host Your guest, possessed of return, with calm.
Lengthen life with the deeds that please You, and give life to my heart with certainty and firmness.
To You is my turning with the Qurʾān that I recite slowly, and with the praise of a Messenger from You, trustworthy.
The blessing of a Kind, Merciful One, with peace together, upon him who spared us all conjecture,
the highest of creation with Allah in rank, Muḥammad, he who came with gladness and safety.
To Allah I have turned, and the Chosen is my intermediary, and I hope my leanness may attain the best fattening.
My need with Allah, through the Chosen, has already been met; may He bless him with His peace. Āmīn.
If I have a need, or if I have fear, I converse with Him intimately, and He enriches me and protects me.
My turning is toward Him Who raises the station without making (the gaze) roam toward the lands of Syria and China.
A Lord Who bestows the folding (of the path), Who can spare burdens, as He saves without sword and without fortification.
I have been the guest of the Generous Who hosts with "Be"; and to Him be my praise and my gratitude, and He raises me in the two Abodes.
Truly I am the guest of the Knower of the unseen, here, and He has tamed for me every adversary who hated me.
He is the All-Powerful Who by folding (the path) brings me to my wish, perpetually, at every time.
I have turned my face with gratitude to the Generous, and He drives to me a mercy from Himself from now on.
I hope, by His gifted mercy, our master (the Prophet), for my visit to his city, the abode of sweet basil.
An abode which, whenever a visitor visits it for guidance, he is made happy: it is the abode, the abode of Truth and religion.
I have stored up my being the slave of Allah, his servant, and his being for me on the day of Gathering and Judgement.
To Allah I have turned through the Chosen, possessed of services, and He has already spared me through him what almost ruined me.
I have intended Your gratitude on this day, O my Eternal Refuge, O Allah, Lord of the ʿAyn before the Rā and the Shīn (al-ʿArsh, the Throne).
O You Who bring into being what You have willed without cause, bring my wish into being, and tame for me what makes me fear.
With the folding and the attraction grant me the request without toil, O Best Enricher, Nurturer Who can set me free.
You have nurtured me: so widen for me here and tomorrow, without reckoning, and be for me when You adorn me.
You have favoured me with what surpassed my request: so spare me at all times every accursed one.
Accept from me, increase my gratitude and increase my succour, and make my gratitude the glad tidings of Your wide-eyed houris.
My turning is toward what pleases You of deed and word; and every evil You spare me.
You spared me thirst and nakedness with hunger, and with the Book You sent down You heal me.
Make the springs of the water of the unseen gush forth in my heart, and protect my tongue from the error of suspicions.
O Lord, bless with peace my support, and the Family with his Companions, the high-nosed (noble and proud).
Bless him and grant him peace, with all, and lead me to al-Baqīʿ which Ibn Maẓʿūn inaugurated (the first buried there).
With the folding (of the path) bestow on me, and tame for me every envious one, contender, pierced by the spear of polytheism.
You are the Answerer (Al-Mujīb) Who saved Noah from drowning with a mighty, laden ark from You (Qurʾān 26:119).
My masters called upon You before, and You were for them: so answer me, O Answerer of every afflicted one.
Bring into being all that I love, forever, with "Be", and tame my enemies for me by training them.
Truly I am a slave, a servant; I have become Your guest, O my Lord, and with manumission and release You host me.
Be for me with "Be" forever, and make my journey, in the midst of the wilderness, for creation like that of the wandering (saints).
I have turned my need to Him Who fulfils everything with "Be", and I seek intercession through the one praised in (the sūra) Nūn (Qurʾān 68:4).
the highest of creatures, the most God-fearing of them and the noblest, with Him Who bestowed on me the Mīm and the Nūn.
For Him Who clothed me, quenched my thirst and fed me, (goes) my grateful pen, like the Tablet and the Nūn (the pen, Qurʾān 68:1).
My love, my affection, my good pleasure and my praise are for Him Who favoured me with what surpassed expectation.
O Lord, bless with peace, without number, a bearer of glad tidings, a warner from You, trustworthy,
Your Prophet, the Chosen, with the righteous together; and be with "Be" for me in the manifest and the hidden.
